newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Commerce Asset says to raise 1.2 bln rgt.
newsitem.headline: Commerce Asset says to raise 1.2 bln rgt.

text.p: Financial group Commerce Asset-Holdings Bhd said on Thursday it plans to raise 1.2 billion ringgit from bonus, rights, bond and special issues.
In a press statement, the company said the one-for-one bonus issue will total 319.16 million shares.
This will be followed by a special issue of 9.034 million shares at 6.50 ringgit a share for Bumiputera (ethnic Malay) investors, the company said.
On completion of the bonus and special issues, Commerce Asset plans to carry out a one-for-five rights issue of 129.47 million shares at 6.50 ringgit a share.
Commerce Asset stock closed Thursday trading at 18.70 ringgit, unchanged from the previous session.
Commerce Asset's executive director Rozali Mohamed Ali told reporters the proposed issues were aimed at increasing working capital and to finance the group's expansion.
But he declined to be more specific.
"We are not making public the provisions we are making," Rozali said. "We'll expand our operations either through internal growth or acquisitions."
Analysts and traders said according to market speculation Commerce Asset is negotiating a stake in the privatisation of Bank Bumiputra Malaysia Bhd.
Commerce Asset said it was also proposing to increase its authorised share capital from 500 million ringgit to one billion.
The proposals are subject to approvals from various regulatory bodies and from Commerce Asset shareholders.
The bank also plans to issue five-year zero coupon bonds to raise 400 million ringgit with 80.92 million detachable warrants, the statement said.
Commerce Asset's stockbroking subsidiary, CIMB Securities Sdn Bhd, will offer the warrants attached to the bond sale in the ratio of one warrant for every eight shares held, it said.
